definitions.explanation: The act of distributing printed materials, goods, or digital content to multiple recipients. Commonly used for flyers, documents, samples, and software.

examples.japanese: チラシを{駅前|えきまえ}で{配布|はいふ}する。
examples.english: To hand out flyers in front of the station.

examples.japanese: {資料|しりょう}は{会議|かいぎ}の{前|まえ}に{配布|はいふ}されます。
examples.english: The materials will be distributed before the meeting.

examples.japanese: このソフトウェアは{無料|むりょう}で{配布|はいふ}されているので、{誰|だれ}でもダウンロードできる。
examples.english: This software is distributed for free, so anyone can download it.

notes:
{配布|はいふ} is a noun that can function as a suru verb ({配布|はいふ}する). It implies distributing copies or items widely to many recipients.

PARTICLE PATTERNS:
- [thing]を{配布|はいふ}する (to distribute something)
- [thing]が{配布|はいふ}される (something is distributed)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- チラシを{配布|はいふ}する (distribute flyers)
- {資料|しりょう}を{配布|はいふ}する (distribute materials)
- {無料|むりょう}{配布|はいふ} (free distribution)
- {配布|はいふ}{物|ぶつ} (handout, distributed material)

Distinct from {配達|はいたつ} (delivery), which implies bringing items to specific recipients. {配布|はいふ} emphasizes wider, less targeted distribution. Also distinct from {配給|はいきゅう} (rationing, supply distribution), which implies controlled allocation.
